title: Sloth Paani Mein 40 Min Saans Kaise Rokta Hai? 🦥 #shorts
idea: Sloths can slow their heart rate to one-third of normal speed to hold their breath underwater for up to 40 minutes.

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai Sloth paani ke andar 40 minute saans rok sakta hai?
Sloth paani mein apna heart rate ek-tihai tak kam kar leta hai.
Zameen par dheema Sloth, paani mein chaar guna tez tairta hai!
Aur ise ek baar ka khana pachane mein poora 1 mahina lagta hai!
Hazaron saal pehle Sloth ka size ek bade haathi jitna hota tha!
Kya aapko Sloth ki yeh underwater superpower pata thi? Comment mein batao!

facts.claim: Sloths can slow their heart rate to less than a third of normal to hold breath underwater for up to 40 minutes.
On the ground maximum speed is 3 m per minute.
Sloths swim at speeds up to 13.5 m per minute.
Digestive process can take a month or more.
Ancient sloths reached sizes of elephants.
